items.claim: Stephen Aspel's takedown defense has improved significantly.
items.quote: Stephen Aspel's takedown defense has gotten a lot better.

items.claim: Guier May Pat is lacking power in his striking.
items.quote: Very confident with his striking to walk people down but lacking the power.

items.claim: Billy Ray Golf has not fought in over a year.
items.quote: We haven't seen him fight in over a year.

items.claim: Tai Miller has a massive reach advantage and uses long-range straight punches.
items.quote: Tai Miller is a lanky one two specialist. He's a good long range boxer with nice volume on his attacks.

items.claim: Billy Ray Golf has good recovery and has come back from being rocked before.
items.quote: Billy Ray Golf's recovery is pretty good. He's been rocked before and he's came back from it.
